description.value: Maverick Estate Winery occupies the Golden Mile Slopes appellation on Highway 97, sitting roughly halfway between Oliver and Osoyoos in the heart of South Okanagan wine country. Founded in 2009 and releasing its first vintage in 2011, the winery follows slow-wine principles—biodynamic and organic farming, natural fermentation, and minimal cellar intervention—producing small-lot wines that aim to express the character of the site. Guests can taste in a tasting room, on a patio, or in the Villa Tasting Garden, and the winery also runs intimate dinners and wine-education Flight School sessions.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is comprehensive and clearly current (copyright 2026); address (3974 Highway 97, Oliver, BC V0H 1T1) and phone (778-437-3133) are confirmed consistently across the home page, contact page, and events page. No cycling-specific amenities—bike racks, water refill, or explicit washroom mention—appear anywhere on the site, leaving those criteria as null. The winery is a legitimate, actively operating business on Highway 97 between Oliver and Osoyoos, a well-travelled South Okanagan cycling corridor.
concerns: OSM record is sparse—no address or phone in OSM tags; both values sourced solely from the website.
Washrooms not explicitly mentioned on the website, though a sit-down tasting room strongly implies they are available on-site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, actively operating estate winery on a premier South Okanagan cycling route; touring cyclists would benefit from a listing for tastings, wine or cider purchases, and a rest stop mid-ride.

wow_evidence: biodynamic and organic farming, natural fermentation, and minimal cellar intervention—producing small-lot wines
